title: Transition from Pagan to Christian Philosophy
description: Discusses the transition of philosophy from pagan to Christian contexts, emphasizing Neo-Platonic influence on understanding Christianity as a revelation of spirit in actuality.

title: Development of Neo-Platonic Philosophy
description: Highlights the development of Neo-Platonic philosophy leading to an understanding of Christianity as a revelation of spirit in actuality.

title: Emphasis on Divine-Human Unity
description: Stresses the role of Christ in revealing the unity of divine and human nature, emphasizing reconciliation with God through grace and faith.
